newsitem.title: NORWAY: Saga's oil, NGL, gas output rises steeply.
newsitem.headline: Saga's oil, NGL, gas output rises steeply.

text.p: Saga Patroleum ASA said on Thursday its total production of crude, natural gas liquids and gas amounted to 25 million barrels of oil equivalent (boe) in the first four months of 1997 compared with 16.3 million boe in the corresponding year-ago period.
Output of available-for-sale gas was 2.8 million boe, more than 11 percent of the group's production, the company said in a statement releasing first tertial results.
Average oil production on the Norwegian continental shelf was 133,800 barrels per day during the four-month period, an increase of about eight percent from the first tertial 1996.
